ex.en: So We took him and his soldiers and cast them into the sea, and he was blameworthy

forms.gloss: to aim for; to perform dry ablution

ex.en: O you who have believed, spend from the good things which you have earned and from that which We have produced for you from the earth. And do not aim toward the defective therefrom, spending [from that] while you would not take it [yourself] except with closed eyes. And know that Allah is Free of need and Praiseworthy
